column1: # Indonesian share of world production, by element.
# Source: U.S. Geological Survey, Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024 (January
# 2024). A work of the United States Government, and therefore in the public
# domain. Figures are USGS estimates for 2023.
# share is Indonesia's output divided by world total, as reported. stage is
# where in the chain the figure is measured (invariant 10) — mined ore or
# refined metal. commodity is the commodity USGS reports, which is not always
# the element itself: aluminium is reported here as bauxite ore.
# Invariant 9: producing nothing and producing a little are different facts.
# Elements USGS tracks as commodities but reports no Indonesian output for are
# listed in tracked.tsv and render as "not produced", not as the bottom of the
# ramp. Elements USGS does not track at all have no production data and render
# Invariant 11: this file states production share. It carries no commentary on
